requiredFindings.title: Workspace member sums omit the charges introduced by nesting
requiredFindings.finding: A standalone automatically discovered repository root is supplied as the lent root. When the same repository becomes an ordinary directory below an overlay root, the walker additionally classifies, spells, opens and status-checks that member, probes its VCS/config boundary, and may capture and memoize its directory custody when a unit chain reaches it. The overlay root listing plus standalone member costs does not account for these transitions. The existing 52 vectors and three mutations do not validate this additive workspace formula.
requiredFindings.requiredCorrection: Model a synthetic composed workspace through the same counting/model path, or specify and prove a conservative per-member transition surcharge, including boundary/depth/pruning and custody effects. Add a native synthetic workspace comparison and a control that removes the transition term. State exactly which workspace traversal the bound represents; actual symlink mounts are not followed.

requiredFindings.title: File length does not bound all charged read attempts
requiredFindings.finding: work_reader.rs:146-190 charges an edge before each read attempt and retries Interrupted without advancing the byte count. Consequently a fixed-length regular .git file has no finite maximum read-attempt count derived from its length alone. The ledger eventually refuses exhaustion, but that does not establish the planned 2x successful-walk margin. The ordinary native vectors do not exercise repeated interruptions.
requiredFindings.requiredCorrection: Define the read/retry envelope and what the census claim bounds. Account for short reads, EOF and interruption retries under an explicit justified bound, or distinguish structural census costs from unbounded retry/exhaustion behavior and reconcile that limitation with the law-level margin claim. Do not present a length-only attempt count as an unconditional native upper bound. Include a focused control for the chosen retry treatment.

requiredFindings.title: The source-pin closure omits a cost-producing dependency
requiredFindings.finding: directory_open.rs:32-42 computes open_child_directory_cost.edges as 1 + path_binding::status_read_cost().edges. The latter is defined in platform/src/filesystem/path_binding.rs:121-126, outside the plan's enumerated source-pin set. Its edge value can change without changing directory_open.rs or its anchored expression. Pinning only the listed files cannot support the claim that every charge change breaks the census.
requiredFindings.requiredCorrection: Include path_binding.rs and the transitive cost expressions used by the model in the pinned/anchored closure. Specify a charge-site-to-formula inventory covering walker direct charges and delegated costs, and require dependency/anchor drift to refuse. Add a control changing the delegated status cost while leaving the calling expression unchanged.
